releaseNotes: ✨ Dedicated Settings Pages: Account, Notifications, and Help & Support now open as clean, full-screen pages with smooth back navigation.
📐 Grid Alignment & Share Button: Master Listing grid cards now have equalized heights with perfectly aligned Share buttons.
🔍 My Listings Filter Fix: All your properties (Active, Booking, Sold, Draft) are now always visible under My Listings by default.
🛡️ Redesigned Feedback & Bug Report: Easily report issues and attach screenshots with comfortable safe-area spacing and gesture back support.
⚡ Lightning Performance: Optimized data loading and smart caching across dashboard and listings.
🔒 Enhanced Privacy & Security: Complete control over PIN app lock, biometrics, and anti-screenshot protection.
🔔 Smarter Notification Inbox: Notifications you've already read or cleared stay cleared on your account, even if you reinstall the app or clear data.
⚡ Real-Time In-App Sync: New announcements and release notes now appear instantly in your Notification Inbox without refreshing.
📲 Direct Notification Routing: Tapping any update or announcement notification opens your Notification Inbox directly.
📱 Better Display on All Phones: Buttons, cards, and text now automatically fit and scale cleanly on every Android screen size and zoom level.
📸 Cleaner Photo Uploads: Neater square photo tiles with easy-to-tap controls when adding and editing listings.
⚡ Glitch-Free Listing Views: Fixed photos occasionally mixing up when switching between My Listings and All Listings.
🔒 Enhanced Security: Server-side admin authentication and direct navigation.
📸 Streamlined 2-Option Share Sheet: Share multi-photo albums with live download progress.
💡 Universal Android Guidance: Send clean albums with auto-caption without repeated text on all Android brands.
📋 1-Tap Copywriting: Instant copy with price/sqft and monthly loan estimates.
🔔 Notifications Inbox: View all past agency announcements anytime from the new bell icon on your Dashboard.
📲 Direct Phone Notifications: Receive important announcements directly in your phone notification center.
🌐 Language Matching: Announcements now seamlessly adapt to your preferred language (English / Bahasa Melayu).
✨ Smarter Dashboard: Dismissed announcement banners stay closed permanently with zero startup flash.
Fixed AuthGuard cold-start: App strictly returns to login after signing out.
